info.name: Restaurant Delivery Control Service API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Restaurant Delivery Management System.

## Available Roles
- ADMIN: Full system access
- OWNER: Restaurant owner access
- MANAGER: Restaurant manager access
- OPERATOR: Back-office operator
- CASHIER: POS cashier (cash drawer, payments)
- WAITER: Front-of-house staff
- SUPERVISOR: Waiter supervisor
- HEAD_WAITER: Head waiter
- KITCHEN_STAFF: Kitchen personnel
- COURIER: Delivery driver
- CUSTOMER: Registered customer
